messages:
carmen: Quick heads-up — scheduling a prep call for the upcoming pentest next Tue. Need RBAC change list, KMS access plan, and audit-log export steps. Who can join?

sam: I can do RBAC review. Do we have scoped roles for assessors or will it be ephemeral?

carmen: Ephemeral preferred. Thinking: a contributor-ish role minus prod-deploy + read-only audit logs. Need rotation window for keys.

liz: For KMS we should use a proxy role + pre-signed evidence bucket. I'll post the exact flow.

mikhail: +1 ephemeral. On KMS: we can't give raw key decrypt. Use envelope keys + wrap/unwrap via kms-proxy. See playbook https://redwood-internal/playbooks/kms-proxy :eyes:

jenn: For logs — we need to export a 7-day window snapshot and produce query samples; SIEM wants PII obfuscated first.

security-manager: Also ensure audit retention policy documented. Add a requirement: logproof hashes for evidence chain and an attestable timeline.

oncall-bot: Bridge created: https://zoom/bridge/6172022345 — Ops page: https://redwood-internal/ops/pt-6172022345

sam: For RBAC changes, propose snippet to create assessor role:

```hcl
resource "rbac_role" "assessor_temp" {
  name = "assessor_temp_pt"
  permissions = ["read:logs", "read:configs", "list:keys"]
  expiry = "2026-03-15T20:00:00Z"
}
```

carmen: Nice. Add an allow-list for source IPs and require MFA. Also need a clear revert plan and short TTL (no longer than 8h).

liz: Will prepare KMS access flow and pre-signed bucket steps by EOD. I'll tag infra for S3 pre-sign TTL and put the runbook in the ops doc.

mikhail: Retest coordination: propose block Fri 18:00-22:00 UTC for retest windows. Ops — can you confirm blackout windows for traffic mirroring?

jenn: QA — can we attach a sanitized eval corpus so assessors can run targeted tests without full data exposure? I can scrub and upload.

carmen: Yes — sanitized prompt corpus will be uploaded to evidence-bucket/sanitized/ by sec-team. Include hash manifest.

security-manager: Action items (short): RBAC PR, KMS proxy config, log export runbook, evidence upload + hash. Sync at 10:30AM Tue. :thumbsup:

sam: I'll open the RBAC PR (ENG-SEC-PT-102) and ping @eng-oncall when ready.

liz: Filing ticket for presign TTL: ENG-PT-321. Will include Terraform module pointer.

carmen: Great. Thanks everyone — meeting invite sent.

oncall-bot: Reminder set for Tue 10:20AM.
